formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x2 x3 : ℕ),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 →     x2 < (14 : ℕ) + x1.size →       x3 < (14 : ℕ) + x1.size →         have x7 : List (ℕ × ℕ) := [((0 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ))];         have x8 : (Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) → Prop := fun (x8 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) => ∃ (x9 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (x10 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), (↑x9, ↑x10) ∈ x7 ∧ x8 x9 = Bool.true ∧ x8 x10 = Bool.true;         have x9 : ℕ → (Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x9 : ℕ) (x10 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) => (x1.wires (List.ofFn x10)).getD x9 Bool.false;         (∀ (x10 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x8 x10 → x9 x2 x10 = Bool.true ∨ x9 x3 x10 = Bool.true) → (∀ (x11 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), ¬x8 x11 → x9 x2 x11 = Bool.false ∧ x9 x3 x11 = Bool.false) → (∃ (x12 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x8 x12 ∧ x9 x2 x12 = Bool.true ∧ x9 x3 x12 = Bool.false) → (∃ (x13 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x8 x13 ∧ x9 x3 x13 = Bool.true ∧ x9 x2 x13 = Bool.false) → (26 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: Heawood graph as in the parent (the same 21 edges), F its edge function on 14 inputs: an AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two with two existing wires a, b, each false wherever F is false, at least one true wherever F is true, and each true at some input where F is true and the other is false, has at least 26 gates.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function of the Heawood graph has at least 27 gates
